text: Only once for this place. I came for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal) and had a male dentist who hurt me terribly. Not only did he scrape off tartar, but he also scraped it off along with my gums. He told me to lift my hand if I couldn't handle it, but I didn't just lift it; I cried. The dentist showed no sign of stopping. I was in so much pain I couldn't breathe. Most importantly, the assistant who was supposed to suction my saliva did so in a very painful way. I've never experienced anything like it before. She kept pressing and digging into my gums, and she didn't stop even when I cried. If she's tired, doesn't want to do this job, or is disgusted by oral cavities, she should find a more suitable job. It was like she was venting her frustration on the patient. The tartar removal process was terrible. This dental procedure needs significant improvement, especially the assistant.
